description: Broken link checker — Crawls one page and checks its unique http(s) links (first limit=, default 25, max 40) with HEAD then GET fallback, 6 at a time: reports broken (404/410/5xx), redirects (with location, permanent flag, http-to-https and trailing-slash hints), restricted (401/403/429/999 - usually bot protection) and unreachable links, with anchor text and internal/external flag. Verdict CLEAN / MINOR ISSUES / BROKEN LINKS plus a 0-100 score. Optional: limit=, external=0 (internal only), scope=internal|external|all, images=1 (also check img src). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_broken_links
